items.difficulty_reason: The author proves completeness by eliminating general symplectic diagrams into graph-like form, deriving affine-with-phases normal forms, then performing a matrix/phase reduction to a unique reduced AP-form. The scalable diagrammatic Schur-complement and row-reduction constructions are retained together with the full empty-semantics and uniqueness arguments. These interacting categorical/symplectic normal-form constructions support H2 without upgrading the label from venue or length.
